def base_convert(s, from_base, to_base):
    if s == "": return ""
    sign = -1 if s[0] == '-' else 1
    s = s[1:] if s[0] == '-' else s
    num = int(s, from_base)
    if to_base == 10: return str(num)
    digits = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    result = ""
    while num > 0:
        result = digits[num % to_base] + result
        num //= to_base
    return result if sign == 1 else "-" + result
```

def base_convert(s, from_base, to_base):
    if s == "": return ""
    sign = -1 if s[0] == '-' else 1
    s = s[1:] if s[0] == '-' else s
    num = int(s, from_base)
    if to_base == 10: return str(num)
    digits = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    result = ""
    while num > 0:
        result = digits[num % to_base] + result
        num //= to_base
    return "-" + result if sign == -1 else result
```
